name: Takatori (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Takatori town emblem in white: three interlocking outlined rings.
history: Municipal flag of Takatori, a town in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 November 1967.

features.role: Takatori town emblem — three interlocking outlined rings
